g.text: POST /api/ai-agents-teams/deploy/prepare + /send — compile and deploy a team behind a registry URI
Before prepare — the registry signature, client-side
and the registry URI on the record
Two keys, two purposes: the REGISTRY key signs
the insertSigned tuple that claims the team's
uri_pub_key); the WALLET key signs the deploys.
The registry signature is computed before
prepare and embedded in the request, which is
why the contract's timestamp is the request's.
Agent code is read fresh from the chain on every
deploy at the referenced (id, version) pins —
nothing is cached between deploys. Raw Graph
deploys carry no wallet address: a graph that
uses agent nodes must be deployed by team id
